Properties.AlarmDescription: Error-budget burn rate over 1 h above 14.4 (SLO 99.5% non-5xx)
Error-budget burn rate over 6 h above 6.0 (SLO 99.5% non-5xx)
HTTP API p95 latency above 2 s in 3 of 5 minutes
Any Lambda invocation in the account was throttled
Lifecycle Step Functions execution failed or timed out
Claimed Lambda concurrency above 80 % of the account quota
Page: fast or slow error-budget burn, or account concurrency exhausted
